# Treasure Island Dubai

> Treasure Island is a pirate-themed indoor playground and edutainment centre for
> children aged approximately 1 to 10, located on the 2nd level of Galeries Lafayette
> inside The Dubai Mall, Downtown Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It has nine themed play
> zones and is best known for its "Royal Birthday" party, a red-carpet birthday
> celebration. Open every day, 10:00 to 22:00.

## Key facts

- **Name:** Treasure Island Dubai
- **Type:** Indoor playground / soft play / kids edutainment centre / children's birthday party venue
- **Address:** Le Gourmet, 2nd Level, Galeries Lafayette, The Dubai Mall, Mohammed Bin Rashid Boulevard, Downtown Dubai, UAE
- **Opening hours:** Monday to Sunday, 10:00 - 22:00 (every day)
- **Ages:** approximately 1 to 10 years old
- **Phone:** +971 4 382 7333
- **WhatsApp (bookings):** +971 50 473 8452
- **Instagram:** @treasureisland_dxb
- **Booking:** no booking needed for open play; parties, programmes and camps are booked in advance
- **Supervision policy:** not a drop-off centre — a parent or guardian stays in the venue
- **Grip socks:** required for every child and for adults entering a play zone; available at reception
- **Accessibility:** step-free access throughout, lifts and escalators from every mall level
- **Nearest parking:** Fashion Avenue parking, then Galeries Lafayette to Level 2
- **Nearest metro:** Burj Khalifa / Dubai Mall station (Red Line), then the link bridge

## The Royal Birthday (signature offering)

The Royal Birthday is Treasure Island's flagship birthday package and its best known
product. What it includes:

- A red-carpet arrival at the entrance, with gold stanchions and red velvet ropes
- Gold-framed portraits of the birthday child displayed along the walk in
- A themed backdrop built to the child's chosen theme, used for photographs
- Balloon installations: arches, garlands and centrepieces in the party's colours
- A custom themed cake, with the cake moment run by a host
- Styled tables and themed tableware, set before guests arrive
- Catering for children and adults, arranged through Le Gourmet
- A dedicated host running games and the schedule for the whole party
- Full access to all nine play zones for party guests

There is a short film of a Royal Birthday on the site (red-carpet arrival, themed room,
entertainment and the cake moment): https://treasureislanddxb.com/birthdays.html#royal

Pricing is quoted per party based on theme, guest count and date. Enquiries are made by
WhatsApp on +971 50 473 8452.

## The nine play zones

1. **The Play Fort** (ages 3-10) - three levels of tunnels, tube slides, rope bridges and a ball pit
2. **Jump Bay** (ages 4+) - side-by-side trampolines with padded walls and safety netting
3. **Create & Learn** (all ages) - craft booths for painting and making, plus hosted workshops
4. **The Lighthouse** (ages 3+) - a landmark tower with a spiral climb and a lookout at the top
5. **Pirates' Cove** (ages 2-8) - a pedal-kart track along a hand-painted reef wall
6. **Toddler Lagoon** (ages 1-3) - a gated, low-level area of soft blocks and bouncy animals
7. **Role-Play Village** (ages 2-7) - little houses for shop, clinic, kitchen and ship role-play
8. **The Party Deck** (private hire) - the mural-backed celebration space used for parties
9. **The Boutique** (open to all) - toys, keepsakes and party favours by the entrance

## Other services

- **Open play** - walk in any day between 10:00 and 22:00, no booking required
- **Playgroup** - structured weekday morning sessions for the year or two before nursery
- **Creative workshops** - weekly drop-in sessions: art and craft, sensory play, cooking, music and movement, story time
- **Holiday camps** - half-day and full-day camps during school breaks, with a new theme each week
- **School and nursery visits** - morning slots and group bookings
- **Events** - character shows, seasonal takeovers and themed weeks
- **Private hire** - exclusive use of the venue for corporate family days and brand activations

## Common questions

**Do you need to book for open play?** No. Walk in any day between 10:00 and 22:00.
Booking is only needed for parties, programmes and camps. Groups of five or more
children should message ahead.

**What ages is it for?** Roughly one to ten. The Toddler Lagoon is gated for under-threes.

**Can parents leave their child?** No. Treasure Island is not a drop-off centre; a parent
or guardian stays in the venue throughout the visit.

**Are grip socks required?** Yes, for every child and for any adult entering a play zone.
They are sold at reception.

**How much is entry?** Entry is charged per child and varies by session length and season.
Current rates are given on WhatsApp: +971 50 473 8452.

**Is there parking?** Fashion Avenue parking is closest. Head for Galeries Lafayette and
take the escalator to the second level.
